name: zinterp_context_parse_float_token
description: zInterp_Context::ParseFloatToken consumes the next token and parses it as a floating-point value.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja still renders the indirect atof x87 return poorly in HLIL; assembly confirms the function returns atof(token) in st0 or loads the original 0.0f constant for a missing token.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c1a00 validates NextToken consumption, null-token x87 zero return, and atof(token) for present tokens.
The native smoke verifies parsing 12.5 and returning 0.0 for past-end token consumption.
